title: Software & Projects
text:
Software


  
    
      
      R package · Shiny appbibliometrix & Biblioshiny
    
    
      Open-source R package for quantitative research in scientometrics and bibliometrics, with the Biblioshiny web interface. I am part of the development team. The SAAS workflow for transparent and reproducible science mapping with Biblioshiny is described in Journal of Informetrics (2026).
      
        Website
        CRAN
      
    
  

  
    
    
      
      R · Shiny appTALL · Text Analysis for All
    
    
      An interactive R-Shiny application for exploring, modelling and visualising textual data, designed for researchers without programming skills. Published in SoftwareX (2026).
      
        CRAN
      
    
  

  
    
      
      R package · 2026themescopeR
    
    
      Social representation analysis via semantic network mapping. It implements the ThemeScope approach to quantitative thematic analysis of digital arenas (Journal of Information Science, 2026).
      
        CRAN
      
    
  



Research projects


  
    
      
      PRIN 2022 · 2023–2026SciK-Health
    
    
      Mapping Scientific Knowledge about health for decision-making (2022825Y5E). Outputs include the SciK-Health open-data dashboard for the multidimensional evaluation of Italian academic health science centers (Quality & Quantity, 2026).
      Related publications
    
  

  
    
      
      PRIN 2022 PNRR · 2023–2026Scientific production & patient care
    
    
      The value of scientific production for patient care in Academic Health Science Centres (P2022RF38Y).
      Related publications
    
  

  
    
      
      FEDER Andalucía · 2024–2026Explainable & trustworthy science
    
    
      Project C-ING-165-UGR23 on explainable, reliable and transferable science through intelligent decision and consensus systems applied to generative language models. PIs: I. J. Pérez Gálvez and M. J. Cobo Martín, University of Granada.
    
  

  
    
      
      Spin-off & lab · since 2020–21K-Synth & VRD Lab
    
    
      Member of K-Synth, an academic spin-off producing knowledge from large, heterogeneous data with statistical and data science methods, and of the VRD Lab, the DiSES laboratory for the analysis and evaluation of research and teaching.
      K-Synth
    
  



Earlier projects include the European project BLUE-ETS (2010–2013), POR Campania FESR "Urban ecotourism for cultural heritage" (2014–2015), and University of Calabria research projects on clustering validation, opinion mining, social media mining and graph-based dimensionality reduction (2013–2018).

      Summer School · NaplesScience Mapping
    
    
      Coordinator and lecturer of the Summer School Science Mapping: Systematic Literature Review with Bibliometrix and Biblioshiny (four editions, 2023–2026) and of its 1st International Edition (June 2025).

      About
      Hi, I'm Maria
      I am a Tenure-Track Assistant Professor (RTDB) in Social Statistics (STAT-03/B) at the University of Naples Federico II, Department of Economics and Statistics, where I also earned my Ph.D. in Statistics. I hold the National Scientific Qualification as Associate Professor (13/D3, valid until 2034).
      My research focuses on quantitative methods for text and data analysis, with an emphasis on computational approaches to social science and bibliometrics. Since 2017 I have been part of the development team of bibliometrix; I co-develop TALL and themescopeR, and I am a member of the academic spin-off K-Synth and of the VRD Lab for research and teaching evaluation.
      Since 2024 I have been a permanent member of the Scientific Committee of JADT (International Conference on Statistical Analysis of Textual Data). I chaired the organising committee of JADT 2022 in Naples and served on the organising committee of CLADAG 2025. I took part in the PRIN 2022 projects SciK-Health and The value of scientific production for patient care in Academic Health Science Centres, and I am a member of the Andalusian FEDER project C-ING-165-UGR23 with the University of Granada. At DiSES I sit on the Visiting Committee (since 2021) and the Communication and Social Media Committee (since 2026).

    Research interests
    What I work on
    
      
        
        Text Mining
        Statistical analysis of textual data, topic and theme extraction, text summarisation and framing detection.
      
      
        
        Sentiment Analysis
        Opinion mining on social media, online reviews and student feedback, including geo-referenced sentiment.
      
      
        
        Science Mapping
        Bibliometrics, conceptual and thematic evolution of research fields, evaluation of scientific production.
      
      
        
        Document Clustering
        Data mining, clustering validation and network-based dimensionality reduction for large document collections.
